description: Total number of unique recipients for the campaign or flow message. Official Klaviyo statistic (OpenAPI spec). Note: the connector previously mapped this as 'sends' — that is a drift; 'sends' is not a valid Klaviyo reporting statistic.
_note: DRIFT: manifest field_id='sends' / source_field='sends' does NOT match the official API. Official statistic is 'recipients'. This is the field that was historically referred to as sends.

description: Total number of email or SMS opens.
Unique opens (one per recipient per message).
Ratio of opens to delivered messages.
Total number of clicks on links in the message.
Unique clicks (one per recipient per message).
Ratio of clicks to delivered messages.
Ratio of clicks to opens.
Number of messages successfully delivered to recipient inboxes or devices.
Ratio of delivered messages to total recipients.
Number of hard and soft bounced messages.
Number of messages that bounced or failed delivery.
Ratio of bounced or failed messages to total recipients.
Ratio of bounced messages to total recipients.
Number of messages that failed to send (carrier or system error, SMS).
Ratio of failed messages to total recipients.
Number of attributed conversions (placed orders or configured conversion metric) within the attribution window.
Unique converters (one per recipient).
Ratio of conversions to total recipients.
Total monetary value of attributed conversions (revenue). Official name of what the connector calls 'revenue' or 'attributed_revenue'.
_note: DRIFT: manifest field_id='attributed_revenue' / source_field='revenue' does NOT match official name. Official statistic is 'conversion_value'.

description: Average order value of attributed conversions.
Attributed revenue divided by total recipients.

Ratio of unsubscribes to total recipients.

Total monetary spend on SMS messages for the period.
